Parse one RAND-style reference entry into structured fields

Source: R/bib-rand.R
rand_parse_entry.Rd

Distinguishes quoted titles (article / incollection) from unquoted titles (book / techreport / misc) and extracts authors, title, container, volume/issue, publisher or institution, year and a same-year disambiguation suffix ("1998a"), plus any URL.

Usage

rand_parse_entry(e)

Arguments

e

A single reference-entry string, as produced by rand_split_entries().

Value

A list of parsed fields: raw, type, authors (data frame), title, container, volume, number, month, publisher, institution, edition, note, url, doi, year, suffix.
